verdict.rationale: Omnara documents following an agent's progress live and sending a correction mid-task, and users can interact through the browser dashboard, so redirecting an in-progress task is supported. It does not document actually handing the task off so the developer can finish the work themselves. Missing for 10: documented takeover of an in-progress task into an editor or local terminal, an explicit handoff of agent state or workspace for a human to finish the work, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work

citations.quote: Follow an agent’s progress live, send a correction while it’s working, or queue up its next task.
Interact with agents directly through Omnara's dashboard or first-party Slack connector.
Agents keep their conversation history across crashes, restarts, and machine disconnects, so work can resume without starting a new conversation.
